Both preflights require assigned /30, positive USB4 GUID/MAC and a unique Reachable neighbor on that interface; no stale/static/unknown observation is promoted.
Observed /32 or full-host masks normalize only to the exact pair; widened ranges and foreign/drifted rules remain refused.
Dedicated CI exercises offline controls; tests do not register firewall rules or create credentials.
Limits: A declared physical MAC is not cryptographic peer authentication; SSH host pins remain separately required.
Fresh reachable neighbor state does not replace source-bound authenticated SSH/file-transfer qualification.
